name: ai_pattern_summarization
description: AI Workflow Pattern: Summarization. A single LLM_CHAT_COMPLETE task references the server-stored meeting_summary_prompt (Definitions > AI Prompts) instead of inlining prompt text, and returns a structured summary.

inputParameters.transcript:
Alex: Alright, let's get into the Q3 planning sync. Agenda today is billing API status, the mobile crash issue, hiring, and the Q3 roadmap doc. Priya, want to start us off?
Priya: Sure. The new billing API is functionally done. We finished integration testing yesterday and  everything passed except one edge case around partial refunds.
Alex: How bad is the partial refund bug?
Priya: Not terrible, but it double-counts tax on partial refunds above $200. I have a fix drafted, just needs a code review.
Alex: Okay, can you get that reviewed today and ping security  for their review too? We need this live before the Friday deploy freeze.
Priya: Yes, I'll ask Marcus to review the code this afternoon and I'll  message the security team right after this call.
Alex: Perfect. Jordan, how's the mobile crash situation?
Jordan: Still not great. Crash rate is  up to 4.2% since the last release, mostly on Android 12 devices. We think it's related to the new image compression library.
Alex: Do we have a fix, or are we looking at a rollback?
Jordan: We don't have a fix yet. My team's been debugging since yesterday but no root cause confirmed. I  think we should plan to roll back tomorrow morning at 9am unless we get a confirmed fix tonight.
Alex: Agreed, let's not drag this out. Jordan,  you own the rollback decision — send an update tonight either way so the on-call team knows what's happening.
Jordan: Will do. I'll post in the  incidents channel by 8pm.
Alex: Thanks. Switching gears, hiring update — Sam, where are we on the two open backend roles?
Sam: We have three  candidates through onsite for the senior role. Panel feedback was strong for two of them. I want to get an offer out to our top choice, Elena, by  end of week.
Alex: Any blockers on the offer?
Sam: Just need finance to confirm the comp band, I'm following up with them today.
Alex: Great,  keep us posted. For the second role, the mid-level one, we're still pretty thin on the pipeline.
Sam: Yeah, only two applicants so far. I'm going to ask the team for referrals again and also open it up to the contractor pool.
Alex: Sounds good. Last item — the Q3 roadmap doc needs to go to the board Thursday. I'll write the first draft today and share it by end of day tomorrow for everyone to comment on.
Priya: Can you make sure the billing API timeline reflects the refund fix delay? I don't want the board thinking it's already fully shipped.
Alex: Good call, I'll flag it as 95% done pending the fix. Anything else before we wrap?
Jordan: Just a heads up, if we do roll back tomorrow, that'll push the next feature release out by about a week.
Alex: Noted, I'll mention that in the roadmap doc too. Okay, thanks everyone, let's regroup Thursday morning before the board meeting.
